title: Column names and a count
prompt: This program looks at the column names of `learners` and compares them with its rows. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
hints: `columns` is a plain Python list of names, so Python prints it the way it prints any list of text.
The names come in the table's column order, from `learner_id` to `plan`.
Count the columns of `learners`, then its rows, and compare the two numbers.
